items.title: How Lindblad is racing ‘for my five-year-old self’ in F1
items.content: Arvid Lindblad may only be half a year into his Formula 1 career, but he has already made an impression – the British teenager going wheel-to-wheel with World Champions from the outset, frequently reaching Q3 and scoring points, and helping to push the Racing Bulls squad up the grid.

summaries.zh: 阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）加入F1仅半年，已展现出色表现。这位英国年轻车手从一开始就与世界冠军同场竞技，常进Q3并取得积分，助力Racing Bulls车队提升排名。
summaries.en: Arvid Lindblad, a British teenager in his first year of Formula 1, has made a strong impression despite limited experience. He has engaged in wheel-to-wheel battles with World Champions, consistently reaching Q3, scoring points, and helping Racing Bulls improve their grid position.
